layout.base: Existing JOBX tokens; 8/12/16/24px spacing, fluid columns, natural Georgian wrapping
layout.controls: Shared styled SelectField and searchable Combobox; no platform-native menus
layout.salary: Use catalogue categories/subcategories; compact toolbar; twelve initial rows, explicit show more; responsive labeled rows; reduced-motion support

admin.navigation: One persistent navigation with searchable labels and URL-addressable sections. Browser back, reload and links retain section.
admin.analytics: Separate from moderation queue. Three views: site activity, vacancy results, posting form. Periods, search, status, sorting and pagination on vacancy results.
admin.semantics: Clicks are interactions, not confirmed applications or unique users. Contact/view ratio labeled explicitly. Breakdown and definitions in expandable detail.
admin.cv: Modal preview for saved and sent resumes, focus and scroll restoration, internal scrolling and PDF action.

swipe.rootCause: Trackpad momentum survives the exit animation and crossed the threshold again on the next card.
swipe.fix: Axis locked per gesture; consume full gesture after one decision; idle boundary allows next action; cancel partial gesture on buttons/undo/filter; pointer displacement read synchronously.
swipe.browserChecks: 13 passed: momentum, new gesture, undo, vertical drift, button during scroll, next-card scroll reset, reduced motion, mobile vertical/horizontal/button, no runtime errors.

release: User authorized production deployment. One push to main triggers existing deploy.yml. No separate Vercel production command. Company portal and editorial generation must remain disabled until their setup is complete.
